megaMenu.description: Optional rich dropdown for a flat top-nav item (column blank) — icon/eyebrow/title/description/featured link + grouped sub-links. Shape: {icon, eyebrow, title, description, featuredLabel, featuredUrl, groups: [{heading, links: [{text, url, desc}]}]}. Managed by webx-studio's Nav Manager (Branding > Navigation). Null/absent = a plain link, no dropdown.
